proof="""From Stdlib Require Import List ZArith Lia.
From compcert Require Import AST Integers Values Memory.
From PidPositionRunPos Require Import Source Execution.
From PidPositionTranslationSupport Require Import MemoryLayout TranslationArithmetic.
From PidPositionTranslationProblem Require Import Spec.

Lemma axis_translation_initialized : forall gh a b axis d,
 AxisTranslation gh a b axis d ->
 (exists r p, load_path Mint32 a gh gh_type (ref_pos axis)=Some(Vint r) /\\
 load_global Mint32 a Source._state state_type (measured_pos axis)=Some(Vint p)) /\\
 (exists r p, load_path Mint32 b gh gh_type (ref_pos axis)=Some(Vint r) /\\
 load_global Mint32 b Source._state state_type (measured_pos axis)=Some(Vint p)).
Proof.
 intros gh a b axis d [ra [pa [rb [pb [RA [PA [RB [PB REST]]]]]]]].
 split; [exists ra,pa|exists rb,pb];auto.
Qed.

Lemma axis_translation_subtractions_safe : forall gh a b axis d,
 AxisTranslation gh a b axis d ->
 (exists r p, load_path Mint32 a gh gh_type (ref_pos axis)=Some(Vint r) /\\
 load_global Mint32 a Source._state state_type (measured_pos axis)=Some(Vint p) /\\
 signed32(Int.signed r-Int.signed p)) /\\
 (exists r p, load_path Mint32 b gh gh_type (ref_pos axis)=Some(Vint r) /\\
 load_global Mint32 b Source._state state_type (measured_pos axis)=Some(Vint p) /\\
 signed32(Int.signed r-Int.signed p)).
Proof.
 intros gh a b axis d [ra [pa [rb [pb [RA [PA [RB [PB [PHY [RBE PBE]]]]]]]]]].
 destruct PHY as [R [P [D [RD [PD ERR]]]]].
 split.
 - exists ra,pa;auto.
 - exists rb,pb;repeat split;auto. rewrite RBE,PBE.
   rewrite common_translation_difference;exact ERR.
Qed.

Definition LegacyInputPair (gh ret:block) (a b:mem) (dx dy:Z) : Prop :=
 InputGoodLegacy a gh ret /\\ InputGoodLegacy b gh ret /\\
 same_except_positions_and_return gh ret a b /\\
 AxisTranslation gh a b Source._x dx /\\ AxisTranslation gh a b Source._y dy.

Theorem corrected_relation_domain_unchanged : forall gh ret a b dx dy,
 InputPair gh ret a b dx dy <-> LegacyInputPair gh ret a b dx dy.
Proof.
 intros gh ret a b dx dy;split.
 - intros [[A _] [[B _] REST]];exact(conj A(conj B REST)).
 - intros [A [B [FRAME [X Y]]]].
   assert (INIT : initialized_positions a gh /\\ initialized_positions b gh).
   { split;unfold initialized_positions;intros axis AX;
     destruct AX as [<-|[<-|[]]];
     [exact(proj1(axis_translation_initialized _ _ _ _ _ X))|
      exact(proj1(axis_translation_initialized _ _ _ _ _ Y))|
      exact(proj2(axis_translation_initialized _ _ _ _ _ X))|
      exact(proj2(axis_translation_initialized _ _ _ _ _ Y))]. }
   assert (SAFE : position_subtractions_safe a gh /\\ position_subtractions_safe b gh).
   { split;unfold position_subtractions_safe;intros axis AX;
     destruct AX as [<-|[<-|[]]];
     [exact(proj1(axis_translation_subtractions_safe _ _ _ _ _ X))|
      exact(proj1(axis_translation_subtractions_safe _ _ _ _ _ Y))|
      exact(proj2(axis_translation_subtractions_safe _ _ _ _ _ X))|
      exact(proj2(axis_translation_subtractions_safe _ _ _ _ _ Y))]. }
   destruct INIT as [IA IB];destruct SAFE as [SA SB].
   exact(conj (conj A(conj IA SA))(conj(conj B(conj IB SB))(conj FRAME(conj X Y)))).
Qed.
Print Assumptions corrected_relation_domain_unchanged.
"""

Lemma signed_int_double_roundtrip : forall n,
 Float.to_int(Float.of_int n)=Some n.
Proof.
 intros n;unfold Float.to_int,Float.of_int,ZofB_range.
 rewrite ZofBofZ_exact.
 2:{ apply IEEE754_extra.integer_representable_n;try reflexivity.
     pose proof(Int.signed_range n);change(-9007199254740992<=Int.signed n<=9007199254740992);lia. }
 assert (LO : (Int.min_signed<=?Int.signed n)=true).
 { apply Z.leb_le;pose proof(Int.signed_range n);lia. }
 assert (HI : (Int.signed n<=?Int.max_signed)=true).
 { apply Z.leb_le;pose proof(Int.signed_range n);lia. }
 rewrite LO,HI;cbn;rewrite Int.repr_signed;reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma conditional_expression : forall ge e m test yes no ty vt vb v,
 Cstrategy.eval_expression ge e m test E0 m vt ->
 bool_val vt(typeof test)m=Some vb ->
 Cstrategy.eval_expression ge e m(if vb then yes else no)E0 m v ->
 sem_cast v(typeof(if vb then yes else no))ty m=Some v ->
 Cstrategy.eval_expression ge e m(Econdition test yes no ty)E0 m v.
Proof.
 intros ge e m test yes no ty vt vb v TEST BOOL BRANCH CAST.
 inversion TEST as [e0 m0 a0 t0 m0' a0' vv0 EV0 VAL0];subst.
 inversion BRANCH as [e1 m1 a1 t1 m1' a1' vv1 EV1 VAL1];subst.
 eapply Cstrategy.eval_expression_intro with(a':=Eval v ty);[|constructor].
 replace E0 with(E0**E0)by reflexivity.
 eapply Cstrategy.eval_condition;eauto.

Lemma loadbytes_from_equal_units : forall n a b blk ofs bytes,
 Mem.loadbytes a blk ofs(Z.of_nat n)=Some bytes ->
 (forall i,0<=i<Z.of_nat n ->Mem.loadbytes a blk(ofs+i)1=Mem.loadbytes b blk(ofs+i)1) ->
 Mem.loadbytes b blk ofs(Z.of_nat n)=Some bytes.
Proof.
 induction n as[|n IH];intros a b blk ofs bytes LOAD UNIT.
 - change(Mem.loadbytes a blk ofs 0=Some bytes)in LOAD.
   rewrite Mem.loadbytes_empty in LOAD by lia;inversion LOAD;subst bytes.
   apply Mem.loadbytes_empty;lia.
 - replace(Z.of_nat(S n))with(1+Z.of_nat n)in LOAD by lia.
   destruct(Mem.loadbytes_split a blk ofs 1(Z.of_nat n)bytes LOAD ltac:(lia)ltac:(lia))
    as[head[tail[HEAD[TAIL EQ]]]];subst bytes.
   replace(Z.of_nat(S n))with(1+Z.of_nat n)by lia.
   apply Mem.loadbytes_concat;try lia.
   + replace ofs with(ofs+0)at 1 by lia.
     rewrite<-(UNIT 0 ltac:(lia));replace(ofs+0)with ofs by lia;exact HEAD.
   + apply IH with(a:=a);[exact TAIL|].
     intros i RANGE;replace(ofs+1+i)with(ofs+(1+i))by lia;apply UNIT;lia.
Qed.

Lemma scalar_load_from_equal_units : forall ch a b blk ofs v,
 Mem.load ch a blk ofs=Some v ->
 (forall i,0<=i<size_chunk ch ->Mem.loadbytes a blk(ofs+i)1=Mem.loadbytes b blk(ofs+i)1) ->
 Mem.load ch b blk ofs=Some v.
Proof.
 intros ch a b blk ofs v LOAD UNIT.
 destruct(Mem.load_loadbytes _ _ _ _ _ LOAD)as[bytes[BY DECODE]].
 rewrite DECODE;apply Mem.loadbytes_load.
 - replace(size_chunk ch)with(Z.of_nat(Z.to_nat(size_chunk ch)))in BY|-* by(rewrite Z2Nat.id;[reflexivity|pose proof(size_chunk_pos ch);lia]).
   eapply loadbytes_from_equal_units;[exact BY|].
   intros i R;apply UNIT;rewrite Z2Nat.id in R;[exact R|pose proof(size_chunk_pos ch);lia].
 - exact(proj2(Mem.load_valid_access _ _ _ _ _ LOAD)).
Qed.

Lemma canonical_frame_load_transfer : forall gh ret a b ch blk ofs v,
 same_except_positions_and_return gh ret a b ->
 blk<>ret ->
 (forall i,0<=i<size_chunk ch ->~translated_byte gh blk(ofs+i)) ->
 Mem.load ch a blk ofs=Some v ->Mem.load ch b blk ofs=Some v.
Proof.
 intros gh ret a b ch blk ofs v[_[_ BY]]RET NOT LOAD.
 eapply scalar_load_from_equal_units;[exact LOAD|].
 intros i R;apply BY;[apply NOT;exact R|exact RET].
Qed.

 same_except_positions_and_return gh ret a b ->
 Mem.store ch a dst ofs v=Some af ->Mem.store ch b dst ofs v=Some bf ->
 same_except_positions_and_return gh ret af bf.
Proof.
 intros gh ret a b dst ofs ch v af bf[NEXT[PERM BY]]SA SB;split.
 - rewrite(Mem.nextblock_store _ _ _ _ _ _ SA),(Mem.nextblock_store _ _ _ _ _ _ SB);exact NEXT.
 - split.
   + intros blk i k p;split;intro H.
     * eapply Mem.perm_store_1;[exact SB|].apply(proj1(PERM blk i k p)).
       eapply Mem.perm_store_2;[exact SA|exact H].
     * eapply Mem.perm_store_1;[exact SA|].apply(proj2(PERM blk i k p)).
       eapply Mem.perm_store_2;[exact SB|exact H].
   + intros blk i NT RET.
     destruct(peq blk dst)as[->|DIFF].
     * destruct(zlt i ofs)as[LEFT|LEFT].
       -- rewrite(Mem.loadbytes_store_other _ _ _ _ _ _ SA dst i 1)by(right;right;left;lia).
          rewrite(Mem.loadbytes_store_other _ _ _ _ _ _ SB dst i 1)by(right;right;left;lia).
          apply BY;assumption.
       -- destruct(zle(ofs+size_chunk ch)i)as[RIGHT|RIGHT].
          ++ rewrite(Mem.loadbytes_store_other _ _ _ _ _ _ SA dst i 1)by(right;right;right;lia).
             rewrite(Mem.loadbytes_store_other _ _ _ _ _ _ SB dst i 1)by(right;right;right;lia).
             apply BY;assumption.
          ++ pose proof(Mem.loadbytes_store_same _ _ _ _ _ _ SA)as LA.
             pose proof(Mem.loadbytes_store_same _ _ _ _ _ _ SB)as LB.
             replace i with(ofs+(i-ofs))by lia.
             eapply loadbytes_equal_subrange;[exact LA|exact LB|lia|lia|lia].
     * rewrite(Mem.loadbytes_store_other _ _ _ _ _ _ SA blk i 1)by(left;exact DIFF).
       rewrite(Mem.loadbytes_store_other _ _ _ _ _ _ SB blk i 1)by(left;exact DIFF).
       apply BY;assumption.
Qed.

Lemma replay_stores_exists : forall us m,
 Forall(fun u=>let '(ch,b,ofs,_):=u in Mem.valid_access m ch b ofs Writable)us ->
 exists mf,replay_stores m us=Some mf.
Proof.
 induction us as[|[[[ch b]ofs]v]us IH];intros m ACCESS.
 - exists m;reflexivity.
 - inversion ACCESS as[|u tail A REST];subst.
   destruct(Mem.valid_access_store m ch b ofs v A)as[ma STORE].
   destruct(IH ma ltac:(eapply Forall_impl;[|exact REST];intros[[[cu bu]ou]vu] VA;eapply Mem.store_valid_access_1;eauto))as[mf RUN].
   exists mf;cbn[replay_stores];rewrite STORE;exact RUN.
Qed.
Lemma replay_stores_value_at : forall i us m mf ch b ofs v,
 nth_error us i=Some(ch,b,ofs,v) ->replay_stores m us=Some mf ->
 Forall(misses_chunk ch b ofs)(skipn(S i)us) ->
 Mem.load ch mf b ofs=Some(Val.load_result ch v).
Proof.
 induction i as[|i IH];intros us m mf ch b ofs v NTH RUN MISS;
 destruct us as[|[[[cu bu]ou]vu]us];try discriminate;
 cbn[replay_stores]in RUN;
 destruct(Mem.store cu m bu ou vu)as[ma|]eqn:STORE;try discriminate.
 - cbn[nth_error]in NTH;injection NTH as<- <- <- <-.
   cbn[skipn]in MISS;rewrite(replay_stores_load_frame _ _ _ _ _ _ RUN MISS).
   eapply Mem.load_store_same;exact STORE.
 - eapply IH;[exact NTH|exact RUN|exact MISS].
Qed.

Lemma global_contract_after_allocation : forall m ma fresh lo hi,
 global_bytes_initialized m ->
 (forall b gv,Genv.find_var_info Execution.ge b=Some gv ->Mem.valid_block m b) ->
 Mem.alloc m lo hi=(ma,fresh) ->global_bytes_initialized ma.
Proof.
 intros m ma fresh lo hi[init[INIT GLOBAL]]VALID ALLOC.
 exists init;split;[exact INIT|].
 intros b gv VAR;destruct(GLOBAL b gv VAR)as[RP BY];split.
 - intros ofs R;eapply Mem.perm_alloc_1;[exact ALLOC|apply RP;exact R].
 - intros RO ofs R;rewrite(Mem.loadbytes_alloc_unchanged _ _ _ _ _ _ ALLOC)by(apply VALID with(gv:=gv);exact VAR).
   apply BY;assumption.
Qed.
Lemma global_contract_after_store : forall m mf ch dst ofs v,
 global_bytes_initialized m ->
 (forall b gv,Genv.find_var_info Execution.ge b=Some gv ->gvar_readonly gv=true ->b<>dst) ->
 Mem.store ch m dst ofs v=Some mf ->global_bytes_initialized mf.
Proof.
 intros m mf ch dst ofs v[init[INIT GLOBAL]]OUT STORE.
 exists init;split;[exact INIT|].
 intros b gv VAR;destruct(GLOBAL b gv VAR)as[RP BY];split.
 - intros i R;eapply Mem.perm_store_1;[exact STORE|apply RP;exact R].
 - intros RO i R;rewrite(Mem.loadbytes_store_other _ _ _ _ _ _ STORE b i 1)
    by(left;eapply OUT;eauto);apply BY;assumption.
Qed.
Lemma global_contract_after_replay : forall us m mf,
 global_bytes_initialized m ->
 Forall(fun u=>let '(_,dst,_,_):=u in
 forall b gv,Genv.find_var_info Execution.ge b=Some gv ->gvar_readonly gv=true ->b<>dst)us ->
 replay_stores m us=Some mf ->global_bytes_initialized mf.
Proof.
 induction us as[|[[[ch dst]ofs]v]us IH];intros m mf GOOD OUT RUN;cbn[replay_stores]in RUN.
 - injection RUN as<-;exact GOOD.
 - destruct(Mem.store ch m dst ofs v)as[ma|]eqn:STORE;try discriminate.
   inversion OUT as[|u tail HEAD REST];subst.
   eapply IH;[eapply global_contract_after_store;eauto|exact REST|exact RUN].
Qed.

Lemma translated_store_pair_preserves_canonical_frame : forall gh ret a b dst ofs ch va vb af bf,
 same_except_positions_and_return gh ret a b ->
 (forall i,ofs<=i<ofs+size_chunk ch ->translated_byte gh dst i) ->
 Mem.store ch a dst ofs va=Some af ->Mem.store ch b dst ofs vb=Some bf ->
 same_except_positions_and_return gh ret af bf.
Proof.
 intros gh ret a b dst ofs ch va vb af bf[NEXT[PERM BY]]TRAN SA SB;split.
 - rewrite(Mem.nextblock_store _ _ _ _ _ _ SA),(Mem.nextblock_store _ _ _ _ _ _ SB);exact NEXT.
 - split.
   + intros blk i k p;split;intro H.
     * eapply Mem.perm_store_1;[exact SB|]. apply(proj1(PERM blk i k p)).
       eapply Mem.perm_store_2;[exact SA|exact H].
     * eapply Mem.perm_store_1;[exact SA|]. apply(proj2(PERM blk i k p)).
       eapply Mem.perm_store_2;[exact SB|exact H].
   + intros blk i NT RET.
     assert(OUT:blk<>dst \/i+1<=ofs\/ofs+size_chunk ch<=i).
     { destruct(peq blk dst)as[->|D];[right|left;exact D].
       destruct(zlt i ofs);[left;lia|right].
       destruct(zle(ofs+size_chunk ch)i);[exact l|].
       exfalso;apply NT;apply TRAN;lia. }
     rewrite(Mem.loadbytes_store_other _ _ _ _ _ _ SA blk i 1)by(tauto).
     rewrite(Mem.loadbytes_store_other _ _ _ _ _ _ SB blk i 1)by(tauto).
     apply BY;assumption.
Qed.
Definition compatible_update(gh:block)(u v:scalar_update):Prop:=
 exists ch dst ofs va vb,u=(ch,dst,ofs,va)/\v=(ch,dst,ofs,vb)/\
 (va=vb\/(forall i,ofs<=i<ofs+size_chunk ch->translated_byte gh dst i)).
Lemma compatible_replay_preserves_canonical_frame : forall gh ret us vs a b af bf,
 Forall2(compatible_update gh)us vs ->
 same_except_positions_and_return gh ret a b ->
 replay_stores a us=Some af ->replay_stores b vs=Some bf ->
 same_except_positions_and_return gh ret af bf.
Proof.
 intros gh ret us vs a b af bf COMP;revert a b af bf.
 induction COMP;intros a b af bf FRAME UA UB.
 - cbn[replay_stores]in UA,UB;injection UA as<-;injection UB as<-;exact FRAME.
 - destruct H as[ch[dst[ofs[va[vb[-> [-> CASE]]]]]]].
   cbn[replay_stores]in UA,UB.
   destruct(Mem.store ch a dst ofs va)as[ma|]eqn:SA;try discriminate.
   destruct(Mem.store ch b dst ofs vb)as[mb|]eqn:SB;try discriminate.
   eapply IHCOMP;[|exact UA|exact UB].
   destruct CASE as[EQ|TR].
   + subst vb;eapply synchronized_store_preserves_canonical_frame;eauto.
   + eapply translated_store_pair_preserves_canonical_frame;eauto.
Qed.
Print Assumptions compatible_replay_preserves_canonical_frame.
")

 assert(PERM:forall b ofs k p,Mem.perm af b ofs k p<->Mem.perm bf b ofs k p).
 { intros b' ofs k p;destruct(peq b' blk)as[EQ|NE].
   - subst b';destruct(zle lo ofs), (zlt ofs hi).

from pathlib import Path;Path('paparazzi/relations/pid_position_translation/attempts/002/NoSubSyntax.v').write_text('From Stdlib Require Import List Bool ZArith.
From compcert Require Import Coqlib Maps AST Integers Values Memory Events Ctypes Cop Csyntax Csem Cstrategy.
From FiveGuidanceSemantics Require Import SourceClosure.
From FiveGuidanceAllOrder Require Import PureSyntax PureDenotation.
From PidPositionSafety Require Import SubtractionObservation.
Fixpoint no_sub(a:expr):bool:=
 match a with
 | Eval _ _|Evar _ _|Eloc _ _ _ _|Esizeof _ _|Ealignof _ _=>true
 | Evalof a _|Ederef a _|Eaddrof a _|Efield a _ _|Eunop _ a _|Ecast a _|Eparen a _ _=>no_sub a
 | Epostincr _ _ _|Eassignop _ _ _ _ _=>false
 | Ebinop Osub _ _ _=>false
 | Ebinop _ a b _|Eassign a b _|Eseqand a b _|Eseqor a b _|Ecomma a b _=>no_sub a&&no_sub b
 | Econdition c a b _=>no_sub c&&no_sub a&&no_sub b
 | Ecall a al _=>no_sub a&&no_sub_list al
 | Ebuiltin _ _ al _=>no_sub_list al
 end
with no_sub_list(al:exprlist):bool:=match al with
 | Enil=>true|Econs a al=>no_sub a&&no_sub_list al end.
Ltac nosub_boolean :=
 repeat rewrite Bool.andb_true_iff in *;
 repeat match goal with H:_ /\ _|-_=>destruct H end;
 try discriminate;repeat split;eauto 12.
Lemma no_sub_context_congr_mut:
 (forall from to C,context from to C ->forall a b,
 no_sub(C a)=true ->no_sub b=true ->no_sub(C b)=true) /\
 (forall from C,contextlist from C ->forall a b,
 no_sub_list(C a)=true ->no_sub b=true ->no_sub_list(C b)=true).
Proof.
 apply SourceClosure.context_contextlist_ind;intros;cbn[no_sub no_sub_list]in*;try(nosub_boolean).
 all:match goal with op:binary_operation|-_=>destruct op;cbn[no_sub no_sub_list]in*;nosub_boolean end.
Qed.
Lemma no_sub_context_congr:forall from to C,context from to C ->forall a b,
 no_sub(C a)=true ->no_sub b=true ->no_sub(C b)=true.
Proof. exact(proj1 no_sub_context_congr_mut). Qed.
Lemma no_sub_context_hole_mut:
 (forall from to C,context from to C ->forall a,no_sub(C a)=true ->no_sub a=true) /\
 (forall from C,contextlist from C ->forall a,no_sub_list(C a)=true ->no_sub a=true).
Proof.
 apply SourceClosure.context_contextlist_ind;intros;cbn[no_sub no_sub_list]in*;try(nosub_boolean).
 all:match goal with op:binary_operation|-_=>destruct op;cbn[no_sub no_sub_list]in*;nosub_boolean end.
Qed.
Lemma no_sub_context_hole:forall from to C,context from to C ->forall a,
 no_sub(C a)=true ->no_sub a=true.
Proof. exact(proj1 no_sub_context_hole_mut). Qed.
Lemma no_sub_lred:forall ge e a m b mf,lred ge e a m b mf ->no_sub b=true.
Proof. intros;inversion H;reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma no_sub_rred:forall ge a m t b mf,
 no_sub a=true ->rred ge a m t b mf ->no_sub b=true.
Proof.
 intros ge a m t b mf NS RED;inversion RED;subst;cbn[no_sub]in*;nosub_boolean.
Qed.
Definition expr_no_sub(s:Csem.state):Prop:=match s with
 | ExprState _ a _ _ _=>no_sub a=true|_=>True end.
Lemma no_sub_estep:forall ge f a k e m t next,
 no_sub a=true ->Csem.estep ge(ExprState f a k e m)t next ->expr_no_sub next.
Proof.
 intros ge f a k e m t next NS STEP;inversion STEP;subst;cbn[expr_no_sub];try exact I.
 - eapply no_sub_context_congr;[eassumption|exact NS|eapply no_sub_lred;eassumption].
 - eapply no_sub_context_congr;[eassumption|exact NS|].
   eapply no_sub_rred;[eapply no_sub_context_hole;[eassumption|exact NS]|eassumption].
Qed.
Lemma no_sub_subtraction_observation:forall ge caller f a k e m,
 no_sub a=true ->subtraction_observation ge caller(ExprState f a k e m).
Proof.
 intros ge caller f a k e m NS FF C x y CT EQ;subst a.
 pose proof(no_sub_context_hole RV RV C CT _ NS)as BAD;discriminate BAD.
Qed.
Print Assumptions no_sub_estep.
')

from pathlib import Path;Path('paparazzi/relations/pid_position_translation/attempts/002/NoSubHiddenPre.v').write_text("From Stdlib Require Import List Bool.
From compcert Require Import Coqlib Maps AST Integers Values Memory Events Globalenvs Ctypes Csyntax Csem.
From FiveGuidanceAllOrder Require Import PureDenotation.
From PidPositionSafety Require Import HiddenResultLhs HiddenResultContext HiddenResultPre.
From PidPositionTranslationAttempt002 Require Import NoSubSyntax.
Module A:=HiddenResultPre.
Module L:=HiddenResultLhs.
Lemma lhs_no_sub:forall sid ires br ret st,no_sub(L.lhs sid ires br ret st)=true.
Proof. intros;destruct st;reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma hidden_no_sub:forall sid ires br ret st fn args post,
 no_sub post=true ->no_sub fn=true ->no_sub_list args=true ->
 no_sub(hidden_expr(L.lhs sid ires br ret st)fn args post(L.sty sid))=true.
Proof.
 intros;unfold hidden_expr;cbn[no_sub];rewrite lhs_no_sub,H,H0,H1;reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma hidden_no_sub_operands:forall sid ires br ret st fn args post,
 no_sub(hidden_expr(L.lhs sid ires br ret st)fn args post(L.sty sid))=true ->
 no_sub fn=true /\no_sub_list args=true.
Proof.
 intros;unfold hidden_expr in H;cbn[no_sub]in H.
 repeat rewrite Bool.andb_true_iff in H;tauto.
Qed.
Section PRE.
Variable ge:genv.
Variable caller leaf:function.
Variable e:env.
Variable k:cont.
Variable m:mem.
Variable sid ires:AST.ident.
Variable br ret:block.
Variable params:list type.
Variable cc:AST.calling_convention.
Variable vf:val.
Variable values:list val.
Variable post:expr.
Hypothesis local_res:e!ires=Some(br,tptr(L.sty sid)).
Hypothesis res_before:Cexec.do_deref_loc ge quiet_world(tptr(L.sty sid))m br Ptrofs.zero Full=
 Some(quiet_world,E0,Vptr ret Ptrofs.zero).
Hypothesis find_leaf:Genv.find_funct ge vf=Some(Internal leaf).
Hypothesis leaf_type:type_of_fundef(Internal leaf)=Tfunction params tvoid cc.
Hypothesis post_no_sub:no_sub post=true.
Definition prepared(fn:expr)(args:exprlist):Prop:=
 A.prepared ge e m params cc vf values fn args /\no_sub fn=true /\no_sub_list args=true.
Definition pre_or_call(s:Csem.state):Prop:=
 (exists st fn args,prepared fn args /\s=A.pre_state caller e k m sid ires br ret post st fn args) \/
 (exists st,s=Callstate(Internal leaf)values(A.frame caller e k sid ires br ret post st)m).
Lemma prepared_pre_no_sub:forall st fn args,prepared fn args ->
 no_sub(A.pre_expr sid ires br ret post st fn args)=true.
Proof. intros st fn args[P[NF NA]];unfold A.pre_expr;apply hidden_no_sub;assumption. Qed.
Theorem pre_all_successors:forall st fn args t next,
 prepared fn args ->
 Csem.step ge(A.pre_state caller e k m sid ires br ret post st fn args)t next ->
 pre_or_call next.
Proof.
 intros st fn args t next PN STEP.
 pose proof(prepared_pre_no_sub st fn args PN)as NS.
 assert(NEXT:expr_no_sub next).
 { destruct STEP as[ES|SS].
   - eapply no_sub_estep;[exact NS|exact ES].
   - unfold A.pre_state,A.pre_expr,hidden_expr in SS;inversion SS. }
 pose proof(proj2(A.pre_all_successors ge caller leaf e k m sid ires br ret params cc vf values post
 local_res res_before find_leaf leaf_type st fn args t next(proj1 PN)STEP))as CL.
 destruct CL as[[st'[fn'[args'[PRE EQ]]]]|[st' EQ]].
 - subst next;cbn[expr_no_sub A.pre_state]in NEXT.
   destruct(hidden_no_sub_operands sid ires br ret st' fn' args' post NEXT)as[NF NA].
   left;exists st',fn',args';split;[exact(conj PRE(conj NF NA))|reflexivity].
 - right;exists st';exact EQ.
Qed.
Theorem pre_progress:forall st fn args,prepared fn args ->
 exists t next,Csem.step ge(A.pre_state caller e k m sid ires br ret post st fn args)t next /\pre_or_call next.
Proof.
 intros st fn args PN.
 destruct(A.pre_progress ge caller leaf e k m sid ires br ret params cc vf values post
 local_res res_before find_leaf leaf_type st fn args(proj1 PN))as[t[next[STEP CL]]].
 exists t,next;split;[exact STEP|eapply pre_all_successors;[exact PN|exact STEP]].
Qed.
End PRE.
Print Assumptions pre_all_successors.
")
